name: wayland-computer-use
description: Local screenshot and desktop input tools for Hyprland on Wayland.

interface.shortDescription: Use Wayland Computer Use in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Inspect monitors and windows, capture screenshots, focus windows, click, drag, scroll, and type on your live Hyprland desktop. Uses grim, wtype and a local ydotool daemon. Screenshots are returned to the model; no independent cloud service is used.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me use Wayland Computer Use.
